Package aor.proj3t.daos.interfaces

Interface TrainingParticipationDAO

All Superinterfaces:
BasicDAO<TrainingParticipation,Long>
All Known Implementing Classes:
TrainingParticipationDAOimpl
public interface TrainingParticipationDAO extends BasicDAO<TrainingParticipation,Long>
Data Access Object interface for TrainingParticipation entity operations.

This interface extends BasicDAO to provide comprehensive operations for managing training participation records. TrainingParticipation entities represent the relationship between users and training programs, tracking enrollment, completion status, and participation metrics.

Key features include:

  • Querying participation records by participant
  • Training time analysis and reporting
  • Participation history tracking
  • Performance analytics and insights

  • Method Details

    • findByParticipantId

      List<TrainingParticipation> findByParticipantId(Long participantId)
      Retrieves all training participation records for a specific participant.

      This method finds all training programs that a user has participated in or is currently enrolled in. Essential for displaying user training history, tracking learning progress, and generating individual training reports.

      Parameters:
      participantId - The unique identifier of the participant. Must not be null.
      Returns:
      A List of training participation records for the specified participant, or an empty list if no participations are found

    • trainingTimeByYearByParticipantId

      LinkedHashMap<Integer,Long> trainingTimeByYearByParticipantId(Long participationId)
      Calculates total training time by year for a specific participant.

      This method provides analytics on training time investment over multiple years. The returned map contains year-to-training-time mappings, where keys represent calendar years and values represent total training hours or duration for that year. Results are ordered chronologically for trend analysis.

      Parameters:
      participationId - The unique identifier of the participant. Must not be null.
      Returns:
      A LinkedHashMap where keys are years (Integer) and values are total training time (Long) for each year, ordered chronologically. Returns an empty map if no training data exists.
